description: This Java interface defines behavior for managing message rate limiting in an AMQP messaging system integrated with Akka actors. It includes methods for starting/stopping message consumers based on rate limits, tracking message acknowledgments, and controlling flow to prevent overloading.

classes.name: MessageRateLimiterBehavior
classes.description: A behavior interface for managing message rate limits, including starting/stopping consumers and handling acknowledgments, parameterized by message ID type.

classes.name: Forget
classes.description: Inner class representing a request to forget redelivery of a specific message ID.

classes.name: AckStatus
classes.description: Inner class representing acknowledgment status of a message, including success indicator and redelivery request.

classes.name: Control
classes.description: Enum used for scheduled control commands such as checking rate limits.

methods.name: log()
methods.description: Returns the logger instance associated with the actor.

methods.name: startMessageConsumerDueToRateLimit()
methods.description: Starts the message consumer when rate limits allow.

methods.name: stopMessageConsumerDueToRateLimit(String reason)
methods.description: Stops the message consumer for a specified reason, typically due to rate limiting.

methods.name: getMessageRateLimiter()
methods.description: Returns the current message rate limiter object maintaining rate state.

methods.name: initMessageRateLimiter(Amqp10Config config)
methods.description: Initializes the rate limiter based on provided configuration, setting up periodic checks if enabled.

methods.name: getRateLimiterBehavior()
methods.description: Constructs and returns the Akka message receive behavior based on the rate limiter state.

methods.name: recordIncomingForRateLimit(S messageId)
methods.description: Records an incoming message ID for rate limiting; updates in-flight and redelivery status.

methods.name: recordAckForRateLimit(S messageId, boolean isSuccess, boolean redeliver)
methods.description: Records acknowledgment for a message, informing the rate limiter of success or failure.

methods.name: checkRateLimitForConsumedThisPeriod(MessageRateLimiter<S>)
methods.description: Checks if the maximum per period has been exceeded and stops consumer if so.

methods.name: checkRateLimitAsScheduled(Control trigger)
methods.description: Periodically invoked to update rate limits and control consumer start/stop.

methods.name: startConsumerDueToRateLimit(MessageRateLimiter<S>)
methods.description: Logs and triggers the start of message consumption when rate limit allows.

methods.name: stopConsumerDueToRateLimit(MessageRateLimiter<S>, boolean, boolean)
methods.description: Logs and stops the message consumer due to rate limit exceedance.

methods.name: logRateLimiter(MessageRateLimiter<S>, String action)
methods.description: Logs current rate limiter state with an action prefix.

methods.name: checkAckStatus(AckStatus<S>)
methods.description: Processes acknowledgment; manages redelivery or completion in the rate limiter.

methods.name: scheduleForgettingPendingRedelivery(S messageId, Duration redeliveryExpectationTimeout)
methods.description: Schedules a timer to forget pending redelivery of a message.

methods.name: forgetPendingRedelivery(Forget<S>)
methods.description: Handles the timer event to forget a redelivery attempt.

methods.name: getMessageConsumerStoppedReason(boolean, boolean)
methods.description: Generates a reason string for stopping the message consumer based on rate limit status.
